site_name: Flat 4, 116 Crouch Hill, Hornsey, London, N8 9DY
description:
The proposal seeks to replace the existing single-glazed timber sash windows with double-glazed timber sash windows. The new windows will replicate the existing design, including horns and glazing bars, ensuring that the fenestration pattern remains unchanged.

The replacement windows will be finished in white to match the existing appearance as closely as possible, within the technical constraints of double glazing. Care has been taken to ensure that the new units maintain similar proportions and detailing, with frame dimensions closely matching the originals.

In addition to preserving the visual character of the building, the proposed windows will significantly improve thermal performance. This will enhance occupant comfort and contribute to reduced energy consumption, thereby delivering environmental benefits.
